g.text: UART RTS/CTS — one byte is ten cells, and the ninth clock is the handshake
RTS HIGH — asserted BEFORE CTS is read
ORDER IS ASSERTED, NOT INFERRED. A driver
that waited for CTS first deadlocks against
a receiver that only raises CTS in response
to RTS, and the TB's second case is exactly
what such a receiver looks like.

LSB FIRST, and the payload is 0x00, 0xFF, 0xA5
on purpose. 0x00 is eight zero bits behind a
start bit and 0xFF is eight one bits, so a bit
period a little long or a little short shows up
in one of them and not the other; and 0xA5
(1010 0101) is not a bit palindrome, so a
transmitter that shifted the wrong way is
